claim: Render a plan in plan-app as a live view over its directive nodes, the way positions already join beliefs. A plan currently references beliefs only in prose; give it the same structural join positions have (PlanApp.BeliefJoin resolves **Belief:** [[id]] refs against the live graph and pills each with active/superseded/dangling state). Then a plan page shows its directives' live status - which are still open desk items, which were materialized, which got superseded - making the plan a dashboard over the obligations it grounds rather than a static doc. Reuses BeliefJoin; needs a plan-side convention for listing directive ids. Holds the b382/b489 boundary: the directive stays the SSOT, the plan is the record/view, never the source of obligation.

evidence.detail: Surfaced while answering whether plans are decomposed into directives (they are not; b382/b489 already make the directive the SSOT and the plan a record). The operator's gesture - 'plan then provenance for the directives, possibly abstracted into directives on top' - points at a real unbuilt feature: plan-app already has the join machinery for positions (PlanApp.BeliefJoin), so extending it to plans is incremental. Tag-overlap review: deps b489 (graph is the index of obligation) and b382 (plans encode intent, not implementation) are the boundary this must hold; no existing directive covers plan-app's belief join, so no conflict.
